# npm-audit-allow.txt
#
# Allowlist consumed by .github/supply-chain/npm_audit_filter.py (job `npm-audit`).
# One token per line; `#` starts a comment (inline comments allowed); blank lines ignored.
# Matching is case-insensitive.
#
# A high/critical finding is WAIVED when ANY of these identifying tokens matches it:
#   - the vulnerable package name              e.g.  tough-cookie
#   - the npm advisory numeric source id       e.g.  1103907
#   - the GHSA advisory id                      e.g.  GHSA-72xf-g2v4-qvf3
#   - the advisory URL                         e.g.  https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-72xf-g2v4-qvf3
#   - the advisory title
#
# Prefer the GHSA id (most precise). A bare package name waives EVERY current and
# future advisory for that package - use it sparingly.
#
# Policy: every waiver is a consciously accepted risk and MUST carry a justification
#         comment and a tracking link. Un-waived high/critical vulnerabilities fail
#         the job closed.
#
# Example (commented out; this repo currently waives nothing):
# GHSA-72xf-g2v4-qvf3  # esbuild dev-server SSRF; dev-only dependency, not shipped. Track: OS#NNN
